report_name: Critical Memory Corruption Flaws Disclosed in Microsoft Edge

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-118306
vulnerabilities.description: A critical memory corruption vulnerability in the FileSystem component of Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code, potentially outside the browser's sandbox, via a crafted HTML page.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-118305
vulnerabilities.description: A high-severity memory corruption vulnerability in the Turbolev component of Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) that could lead to code execution outside the browser's sandbox.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-118304
vulnerabilities.description: A high-severity improper input validation vulnerability in the SVG component of Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) that could be exploited to achieve arbitrary code execution within the browser's sandbox.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-118315
vulnerabilities.description: A high-severity improper input validation vulnerability in the SVG component of Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) that could be exploited to achieve arbitrary code execution within the browser's sandbox.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-118337
vulnerabilities.description: A high-severity improper access control flaw in the Forms component of Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) that could allow a remote attacker to bypass the Same-Origin Policy (SOP).

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-91732
vulnerabilities.description: A medium-severity missing authorization vulnerability in the AppManifest component of Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based).

indicators.name: Microsoft Edge Spawning Suspicious Child Process
indicators.pattern:
title: Microsoft Edge Spawning Suspicious Child Process
id: 2b9c1f8a-7e6d-4c3b-8a1f-9e2d3c4b5a6b
status: experimental
description: 'Detects Microsoft Edge spawning command-line interpreters, which may indicate a successful sandbox escape and remote code execution following exploitation of vulnerabilities like CVE-2026-118306.'
references:
  - https://www.tenable.com/plugins/nessus/374566
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-01
tags:
  - attack.t1203
  - attack.t1059
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\msedge.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
  condition: all of selection_*
indicators.description: Detects Microsoft Edge spawning command-line interpreters, which may indicate a successful sandbox escape and remote code execution.
